rca of the issue: Confirmed fix matches the agent-to-agent context: backend GET /api/chats/{id} previously derived linked_dev_project via db.dev_projects.find_one({'workspace_id': ws, 'related_chat_id': chat_id}) which returns whichever project Mongo returned first regardless of which one was 'active', so flipping chat.linked_dev_project_id via /active-dev-project/{pid} had no effect on the response shape — and the frontend iframe (key was a stable string) didn't re-mount. Fix is two-fold and both halves verified: (1) routes/chats.py get_chat (lines 220-230) and list_chats (lines 91-134) now read chat.linked_dev_project_id first and only fall back to related_chat_id for legacy chats; (2) LivePreviewPane.jsx iframe key is now `${project.id}:${refreshKey}` so a pid change forces React to unmount/remount the iframe and re-fire the load event. Spin-up endpoint (chats.py:498) writes the pointer on creation. End-to-end Playwright confirms both iframe src AND header pill update on switcher row click.
